# Grandet

> Grandet helps people find cheap, easy-to-connect model APIs. The website grandet.ai compares prices and shows supplier evidence. Grandet Skill 0.3.0 (public preview) brings the same lookup into agents. An anonymous MCP server at https://grandet.ai/mcp offers the same lookup to any MCP client. This repository also holds a dated catalogue of 73 official programmes, 34 third-party promotions and 642 structured prerequisites.

## If a user asks you to install Grandet
Read https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/blob/main/INSTALL.md and follow the section "For the installing agent". Default fresh installs to the registered skill-v0.3.0-build.20261017b ZIP/.skill attachments below; verify downloads/manifest.json plus downloads/releases.json. Both archives include the receipt-aware installer, module, Python verifier and build manifest. Reuse checkouts/caches without forced downloads. Do the setup yourself; the user only handles sign-ins or permission prompts.
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/tree/main/skills/grandet-api-price-finder : the complete Skill (install the whole folder, not SKILL.md alone)
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/releases/download/skill-v0.3.0-build.20261017b/grandet-api-price-finder-0.3.0.zip : installation package for agents
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/releases/download/skill-v0.3.0-build.20261017b/grandet-api-price-finder-0.3.0.skill : native Skill package for upload screens
- https://api.skillhub.cn/api/v1/download?slug=grandet-api-price-finder&version=0.3.0-build.20261017.2 : the same kit from Tencent SkillHub for mainland China or when GitHub is slow (the .skill contents at the archive root; extract into a folder named grandet-api-price-finder)
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/blob/main/skills/grandet-api-price-finder/references/installation.md : install location and status for each app
- https://grandet.ai/public-data/price-finder.json : website interface description
- https://grandet.ai/mcp : anonymous Streamable HTTP MCP server

Install once in the agent's persistent scope. Later questions about API prices, suppliers, quality, speed or reliability should trigger the Skill without the user naming Grandet. Price lookup needs no Grandet account or API key. An install route existing for an app does not mean it has been tested there. Listed prices and supplier statements don't prove model quality or identity.

## Catalogue data
- https://github.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/catalogue-index.json : machine-readable entry index
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/data/RELEASE-v3.json : schema, SHA-256, observation policy and release status
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/data/free-tokens-v3.json : complete reviewed v3 records and conditions
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/CATALOGUE-v3.md : full bilingual records
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/METHODOLOGY.md : how the data was compiled
- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/DATA-LICENSE.md : source rights

## Reading the data
Compiled 2026-10-06. Each record's checkedAt/observedAt and evidence dates are the original observation dates, not refresh dates. Read every condition, billingText, requirement and evidence link before summarising. Unknown does not mean "no requirement". Original units are not converted to tokens or cash. Provider statements say nothing about a particular person's eligibility, upstream quality or successful redemption. Offers depend on time and provider terms, so some records may be historical. Coverage is researched but not exhaustive.

## Status
Website: https://grandet.ai . Current status metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hanzohanzhe/Grandet/main/WEBSITE-STATUS.json . Older release manifests keep the status they had when published. The desktop client and the website source are not in this repository. No automatic data updates are enabled.

Being public on GitHub does not guarantee search or AI indexing. GitHub code search covers indexed default-branch code and requires sign-in, so prefer the direct raw URLs above. See https://docs.github.com/en/search-github/github-code-search/about-github-code-search and https://docs.github.com/en/repositories/creating-and-managing-repositories/repository-limits .

Installation receipts: random IDs and finite categories, content digest and time, 24-month retention; no local paths, usernames, chats or keys. Disable with --no-telemetry or GRANDET_INSTALL_TELEMETRY=0. Installation-stage only; native upload without callback/readback stays NOT_RUN.


Product/API version is 0.3.0. Build `grandet-skill-0.3.0-build.20261017b`, Release tag `skill-v0.3.0-build.20261017b`: both archives include Node installer, receipt module, Python verifier and build manifest; no companion download. Prior installations are not backfilled. Native acceptance remains NOT_RUN.
